chunks: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the saying of God, Blessed and Exalted:
'And what do the Signs and the Warners avail a people who do not believe?'
He said: 'The Signs — they are the Imams, and the Warners — they are the Prophets (peace be upon them).'

key_terms.النُّذُرُ: Warners — interpreted as the Prophets who warn people
key_terms.الْآيَاتُ: Signs — interpreted here as the Imams, who are living signs/proofs of God
key_terms.تُغْنِي: To avail, benefit, or suffice — the Signs do not benefit those who refuse to believe

ai.seo_question: Who are the Signs (ayat) and Warners (nudhur) in Quran 10:101 according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Dawud al-Raqqi asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the verse from Surah Yunus (10:101) which questions the benefit of divine Signs and Warners to those who refuse to believe. The Imam provided an esoteric (batin) interpretation, identifying the 'Signs' (ayat) as the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt and the 'Warners' (nudhur) as the Prophets. This hermeneutic demonstrates the Shia theological principle that Quranic terms have both exoteric and esoteric meanings, with the Imams serving as living, embodied divine signs.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Hilal, from Amiyya Bin Ali, from Dawood Al Raqqy who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj Blessed and High [10:101]
Say: Look at what is it that is in the skies and the earth; and the Signs and the warners do not avail a people who would not believe.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Signs, they are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, and the ‘Warners’, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from MuAlia ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ’Abdallah from Ahmad ibn Hilal from ’Umayyah ibn Ali from Dawud al-Riqqi who has said that he asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of the words of Allah in the following verse.
“The signs and warnings are of no avail to the disbelieving people.” [10:101]
The Imams (a.s.) said, “Signs are the Imams (a.s.) and warnings are the prophets (s.a.).”
